new_problems: Project header under 'ask' with the API key able to run: 'Ready: 2 tasks; nothing runs until 02:51 (your subscription's limit)' (steps/06-after-p2-subscription-then-ask-start-dialog.txt). It is true that nothing runs by itself, but the Start dialog then offers 'Use API key' now. A later words pass could say 'nothing runs by itself until 02:51'. The status line is d1109-run-visible's (project-status.ts); not changed here.

The plan card's per-task wait line under 'then wait' still says 'Press Start and the work starts then.' (steps/02-after-p1-default-plan-card.txt), but the card's own button is 'Approve and start' and the Start dialog's button is 'Start at HH:MM'. This is credential-wait.ts waitThenStartSentence (W15-66, shared by New task and Settings). CS-4 said the per-task lines stay unchanged, so this area left it as it is.

Session page 'Last result' for a session that ended to wait under 'ask' reads '... 1 task waits on other tasks. CHF 0.00.' (steps/25-after-c-session-waits.txt): 'CHF 0.00' is a real spend, not an estimate, so it does not break rule 7, but it adds nothing. This is the session result's sentence (result.ts, d1109-starts-engine).
notes_for_other_areas: StartCredentialView.runOut gains stoppedLine (startStoppedLine). GET /projects/:id/start-check puts it in blocked.sentence when the start is startable and runOut is offered: 'Your subscription is at its limit until 15:40.' replaces 'Nothing can run until 15:40 (...). Press Start at 15:40 and the work starts then.' A kept start alone keeps the old sentence. continuation.test.ts S-10 was updated with its intent kept. The fake daemon mirrors it.

RuntimeApp.chooser.batch() now returns the chooser function with an optional `billing` (a RouterTaskBilling view from withVaultMemo()). Read the credentials through `batch.billing` in a request that also uses the batch (GET /inbox does this), so the vault is asked once per credential. RouterTaskBilling.withVaultMemo() is for views only, never for picks.

Under a preset whose rule is 'next' (subscription_then_key, key_then_subscription), compose's chooserBatch returns the next saved credential that is not resting and can do the task, not the first choice's wait line. This affects the plan card, New task and Settings' specialists' runsOn.

askCardWords and refusedAskWords take estimateChf as 'CHF 0.40', 'less than CHF 0.01' (moneyWords) or 'CHF 0.00' (no figure known: ', at a cost per use'). The ask's estimate (compose `ask`) includes the claimed and in-progress tasks' remaining estimates.
RunIndicator.tsx: the run's links render in data-testid run-links right after the words. CancelWait and its run-cancel-explain stay on the right. d1109-selftasks-chat does not touch this.

StartSessionDialog: start-session-explain is hidden while runOut is shown. Its text is `${blocked.startLabel}: works until ...` for a kept start ('Start at 15:40: ...'), else 'Start: works until ...'.

Owner question default (one constant): ONE_OFF_UNDER_WAIT = true in packages/runtime/src/daemon/credential-policy-view.ts. A one-off 'Use API key' is offered under 'then wait' too; false limits it to 'ask before API key'.

Suggested UPDATE-LOG/CHANGELOG lines for the session lead: 'Settings has one place for which Claude does the work (five presets, the default shown as used until you pick); the Start dialog, the plan card, rows, the status line, the run bar, the session page, the drawer, Costs and chat say what happens when the first choice runs out, what a move to the API key cost, and offer Use API key or Start at 15:40 with their consequences (U-078, ADR 0120).'

Live check 4 steps for this area: (1) Settings > 'Which Claude does the work': both credentials saved, 'Subscription first, then wait' shown as used, rows show states and the month's CHF. (2) Choose 'Subscription first, ask before API key'. Run work until the real subscription meets its limit: one Inbox card 'Use your API key until HH:MM?' with a non-zero 'about CHF x' (never 0.00); the bar reads 'waiting until HH:MM, then it goes on' with Answer next to the words. (3) Press Use API key: the session goes on, its page shows the switch line, the drawer's run reads 'On your API key after your subscription's limit · CHF x', and Costs > By credential agrees with the ledger. (4) Under 'then wait', ask chat a question: hold reply with Use API key and its CHF; press it once and confirm one answer on the key with the note. (5) Under 'Subscription first, then API key' with the limit hit: the plan card's task lines name no wait, and one notification of the move with its cost arrives.
